This notebook reconstructs the condition-only community analysis present in the
original poster workflow and adds design-aware sensitivity analyses for the MAG
and high-quality vOTU communities. The experiment contains one membrane per
condition; consequently, every treatment coefficient is explicitly exploratory
and cannot separate treatment from membrane identity.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_community_differential_abundance.qmd [output-directory]
```

For a versioned figure-only revision from the existing checksum-bound tables,
append `--figure-only` after a new output directory. This does not refit models
or ordinations. Add `--publication-size` alongside `--figure-only` for the
180 mm-wide master with archived notebook and input provenance. Publication
mode refuses to execute without `--figure-only`. Existing runs remain intact.

```{r}
#| label: community-differential-abundance
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

promote_file <- function(source, destination) {
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  incoming <- paste0(destination, ".incoming-", Sys.getpid())
  if (!file.copy(source, incoming, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE)) {
    abort("Failed to stage %s", basename(destination))
  }
  if (file.exists(destination)) unlink(destination)
  if (!file.rename(incoming, destination)) abort("Failed to promote %s", basename(destination))
}

extract_accession <- function(x) sub(".*(ERR[0-9]+).*", "\\1", x)

bray_curtis <- function(x) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  n <- nrow(x)
  answer <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(rownames(x), rownames(x)))
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) for (j in (i + 1L):n) {
    denominator <- sum(x[i, ] + x[j, ])
    value <- if (denominator > 0) sum(abs(x[i, ] - x[j, ])) / denominator else 0
    answer[i, j] <- answer[j, i] <- value
  }
  as.dist(answer)
}

partial_pseudo_f <- function(distance, reduced, full) {
  n <- attr(distance, "Size")
  delta <- as.matrix(distance)^2
  centering <- diag(n) - matrix(1 / n, n, n)
  gower <- -0.5 * centering %*% delta %*% centering
  projection <- function(x) x %*% qr.solve(crossprod(x), t(x))
  h_reduced <- projection(reduced)
  h_full <- projection(full)
  df_term <- qr(full)$rank - qr(reduced)$rank
  df_residual <- n - qr(full)$rank
  ss_term <- sum(diag((h_full - h_reduced) %*% gower))
  ss_residual <- sum(diag((diag(n) - h_full) %*% gower))
  c(F = (ss_term / df_term) / (ss_residual / df_residual),
    R2_partial = ss_term / (ss_term + ss_residual),
    df_term = df_term, df_residual = df_residual)
}

paired_permanova <- function(counts, metadata) {
  relative <- sweep(counts, 1L, rowSums(counts), "/")
  distance <- bray_curtis(relative)
  reduced <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle, metadata)
  full <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle + condition, metadata)
  observed <- partial_pseudo_f(distance, reduced, full)
  cells <- interaction(metadata$phase, metadata$cycle, drop = TRUE)
  if (any(table(cells) != 2L)) abort("Restricted permutations require two conditions per phase-cycle cell")
  cell_levels <- levels(cells)
  patterns <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(c(FALSE, TRUE)), length(cell_levels))))
  permuted_f <- apply(patterns, 1L, function(swaps) {
    permuted <- metadata
    for (k in seq_along(cell_levels)) {
      idx <- which(cells == cell_levels[[k]])
      if (swaps[[k]]) permuted$condition[idx] <- rev(permuted$condition[idx])
    }
    full_permuted <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle + condition, permuted)
    partial_pseudo_f(distance, reduced, full_permuted)[["F"]]
  })
  c(observed, exact_p = mean(permuted_f >= observed[["F"]] - 1e-12),
    permutations = length(permuted_f))
}

matched_clr <- function(feature_counts, metadata, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  log_counts <- log(feature_counts + pseudocount)
  clr <- sweep(log_counts, 2L, colMeans(log_counts), "-")
  cells <- unique(metadata[, .(phase, cycle)])
  setorder(cells, cycle, phase)
  differences <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(i) {
    control <- metadata[phase == cells$phase[[i]] & cycle == cells$cycle[[i]] & condition == "control", sample_title]
    treatment <- metadata[phase == cells$phase[[i]] & cycle == cells$cycle[[i]] & condition == "treatment", sample_title]
    clr[, treatment] - clr[, control]
  }, numeric(nrow(feature_counts)))
  rownames(differences) <- rownames(feature_counts)
  patterns <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(c(-1, 1)), ncol(differences))))
  observed <- abs(rowMeans(differences))
  exact_p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(differences)), function(i) {
    permuted <- abs(as.vector(patterns %*% differences[i, ]) / ncol(differences))
    mean(permuted >= observed[[i]] - 1e-12)
  }, numeric(1))
  data.table(
    feature_id = rownames(differences),
    mean_clr_difference = rowMeans(differences),
    median_clr_difference = apply(differences, 1L, median),
    treatment_higher_cells = rowSums(differences > 0),
    control_higher_cells = rowSums(differences < 0),
    exact_signflip_p = exact_p,
    exact_signflip_fdr = p.adjust(exact_p, "BH"),
    matched_cells = ncol(differences),
    pseudocount = pseudocount
  )
}

run_deseq <- function(feature_counts, metadata, design, model_name) {
  rounded <- round(feature_counts)
  storage.mode(rounded) <- "integer"
  col_data <- as.data.frame(metadata[match(colnames(rounded), sample_title)])
  rownames(col_data) <- col_data$sample_title
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = rounded,
    colData = col_data,
    design = design
  )
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10L) >= 3L
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)
  result <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(
    results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "treatment", "control"), alpha = 0.05)
  ), keep.rownames = "feature_id")
  result[, absolute_log2_fold_change := abs(log2FoldChange)]
  setorder(result, padj, pvalue, -absolute_log2_fold_change, na.last = TRUE)
  result[, `:=`(
    model = model_name,
    tested = !is.na(pvalue),
    supported_fdr05 = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
    supported_fdr05_lfc1 = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1
  )]
  result
}

make_pcoa <- function(sample_counts, metadata, layer) {
  relative <- sweep(sample_counts, 1L, rowSums(sample_counts), "/")
  ordination <- cmdscale(bray_curtis(relative), k = 2L, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
  points <- data.table(
    sample_title = rownames(ordination$points),
    axis1 = ordination$points[, 1L], axis2 = ordination$points[, 2L],
    axis1_percent = 100 * ordination$eig[[1L]] / sum(ordination$eig[ordination$eig > 0]),
    axis2_percent = 100 * ordination$eig[[2L]] / sum(ordination$eig[ordination$eig > 0]),
    community = layer
  )
  merge(points, metadata, by = "sample_title", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
}
```
